searchText: <@404008509114417154> Thanks best way for a php developer as myself to dive into blockchain programming? especially on the ethereum network? I will start with eth...org official documentation My first recommendation is to learn a language besides PHP. Shouldn't be too hard, but worth it as PHP is not particularly good at doing any kind of security critical engineering and there are basically no integrations with PHP. If you want to write contracts, then Solidity. For applications, TypeScript. For clients, Rust, Go, C#, Java. I'm not even sure still what aspect is more interesting to me - contracts, apps or clients.. Is there any general tutorial that will at least point me to the right references? I mean, when you say clients - what exactly do u mean? Clients for me are basically frontend apps that interact with the backend in some way I guess the approach is somewhat different when talking about ethereum, or about blockchain, in general.. You can think of clients as the "backend" and webapps as the "frontend".
